skills.name: Scorpion Sting (蠍刺)
skills.description: Sasori Onna flashes towards a single target and slashes them twice with her tail and claws, dealing damage equal to 50% of her ATK with each slash.

skills.name: Dark Remedy (以毒攻毒)
skills.description:
When Scorpion Venom is detonated and deals damage, Sasori Onna's HP is recovered by 20% of the damage dealt.
Each layer of Scorpion Venom increases Sasori Onna's ATK by 20%. ; : ;Scorpion Venom (蠍毒) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Exclusive effect. Each layer decreases the target's DEF by 80, max 5 layers. Increases by 1 layer after it is detonated. Decreases by 1 layer when the target's HP is healed by 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Scorpion Venom also inflicts 40% of Healing Down on the target.
Recovered HP from detonated Scorpion Venom increases to 30%.
When there is 1 or more layers of Scorpion Venom, each layer inflicts 10% of Healing Down on the target.

After the target with 5 layers of Scorpion Venom receives indirect damage, also deals additional indirect damage equal to 60% of the damage they took to all other enemies (cannot exceed 800% of her ATK).

skills.name: Vicious Venom (百蠍の毒)
skills.description:
Sasori Onna summons the Lord of Scorpions to sting an enemy, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK and inflicts them with Scorpion Venom.
If the enemy is already inflicted with Scorpion Venom, it detonates on them instead and deals indirect damage equal to 75% of Sasori Onna's ATK.
Only 1 enemy can be inflicted with Scorpion Poison. ;Scorpion Venom (蠍毒) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Exclusive effect. Each layer decreases the target's DEF by 80, max 5 layers. Increases by 1 layer after it is detonated. Decreases by 1 layer when the target's HP is healed by 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Scorpion Venom detonates at the end of the target's turn, dealing indirect damage equal to 90% of her ATK.

bio.condition: Team Sasori Onna and another player's Suzuka Gozen and clear any zone 10 times.
